Dental Instruments
Uterine Manipulator

A laparoscopic uterine manipulator is used in gynecological surgeries to reposition and stabilize the uterus, enhancing surgical access and visualization. It is essential for procedures like hysterectomy, myomectomy, endometriosis surgery, and fertility treatments.

VIEW PRODUCTS
Beauty Instruments
Trocar Cannulas

Laparoscopic trocar cannulas create access for instruments and maintain pneumoperitoneum in minimally invasive surgery. They enable gas insufflation, specimen retrieval, suction, irrigation, and visualization.

VIEW PRODUCTS
Medical Instruments 4
Laparoscopic Graspers

Laparoscopic graspers are used for holding, manipulating, and retracting tissues or organs during minimally invasive surgery. They aid in dissection, suturing, specimen removal, and precise surgical maneuvering.

VIEW PRODUCTS
Medical Instruments 6
suction irrigation

Laparoscopic suction irrigation is used to remove fluids, blood, and debris from the surgical site for better visibility. It also delivers irrigation solutions to clean and maintain a clear operative field during minimally invasive procedures.
